body:
## Story Points: 8 | Priority: P0 | Sprint: 3

## Summary
Comprehensive automated test coverage: unit tests for business logic, integration tests for API endpoints and security boundaries.

## Test Suite (71 tests, 0 failures)

### Unit Tests (Mockito)
- AuthServiceTest: 9 tests - registration, duplicate, role enforcement, concurrent duplicate, login, lock/inactive
- VehicleServiceTest: 13 tests - CRUD, ownership checks, duplicate plate
- ParkingServiceTest: 12 tests - entry/exit ownership, fee calculation, grace period, full lot, slot CRUD

### Integration Tests (Spring Boot Test + H2)
- AuthControllerTest: 7 tests - registration, duplicate email, role elevation blocked, weak password, login, locked
- UserControllerTest: 5 tests - unauthenticated, profile GET/PUT, no passwordHash in response
- VehicleControllerTest: 9 tests - ownership, duplicate plate, plate normalization
- ParkingControllerTest: 8 tests - entry, duplicate session, exit+receipt, history, active session
- AdminControllerTest: 8 tests - dashboard, rates CRUD, report, role enforcement (403)

## Run Command
```
cd src/backend && mvn test
```

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] All 71 tests pass with no failures
- [ ] No MySQL required (H2 in-memory for tests)
- [ ] Role elevation in registration is explicitly tested
- [ ] Ownership boundaries tested (vehicle, session, history)
- [ ] Admin-only endpoints return 403 for customer role
- [ ] Password hash never appears in any test assertion or response

## Definition of Done
mvn test exits 0; all 71 tests pass; no security test skipped or disabled.
